And it doesn't really matter if we tell a story about something that has physical, you know, objective reality that we might be able to find the answer about. Or if it's something that is made up, or something that he made up. (0:48:37)

The story is what's real. And what's real is, you know, what happens when I tell you a story and give you an experience. And that experience for him is the driving motivation. And so yeah, truth and fiction don't come into it. It is the storytelling process is kind of neutral on the truth. And that is really the approach that he was taking. Yeah, absolutely. (0:49:11)

Absolutely. What were some of the most surprising things or like the most bizarre things you discovered in researching Barker's life and all his cohorts and enemies and friends and in all of this? What did you come out on the other side being like, wow, was not expecting that? Yeah, so one of the biggest ones was Wilhelm Reich. So Wilhelm Reich was a kind of student of Sigmund Freud, fled essentially Nazi persecution to the US in the 1930s or 40s, and then got interested in weird stuff. (0:49:50)

So he developed this orgone theory, which is, you know, we can talk about that another day, perhaps the details of that. There is a fantastic book that just came out last year by a guy named James Reich, no relation, called Wilhelm Reich versus the flying saucers that really digs into Wilhelm Reich's interest in UFOs, because he did get very interested in UFO stuff. (0:50:15)

And in fact, just last week, when I was at the archive in Clarksburg, I found a letter from Reich's daughter, Ava Reich, who was kind of assisting him in his experiments in this period, to Gray Barker, subscribing to the Saucerian. So he was not just interested, but was, you know, actively part of the culture. But in the late 50s, Reich had basically been enjoined from building some of his devices, which he was selling through the mail. (0:50:53)

The Food and Drug Administration had said, like, you're saying that these can cure things, and there's no proof of that. They're basically treating him like a quack doctor. And he refused to stop, you know, his research. And he was arrested for it, and he died in prison. So while he was imprisoned, Barker got a phone call from Dr. Ava Reich, saying, you know, my father has been persecuted for his, among other things, his belief in UFOs. And having read what you've written about Albert K. Bender, I wonder if there's anything you can do to help us. (0:51:28)

But Barker doesn't know who she is. He's never heard of Wilhelm Reich. It's not, you know, an area of culture that he's aware of. And so he, this is a case where he actually did write this off as a crackpot, is calling me. He did include this in kind of a year-end letter that he was sending to some of his friends, that concludes, like, does anyone know anything about this Dr. Reich? But by the time he did that, Wilhelm Reich was already dead. (0:51:58)

And so years later, in the 1970s, he now knows who Wilhelm Reich is, and he writes another editorial on this saying, I wish I had known at the time. But what's really surprising to me about it is Barker is a guy who is interested in stories of people who are interested in flying saucers being silenced for their views. (0:52:13)

That's the story he's been spinning. And here's one undisputable case of that happening. And he didn't take the bait. He didn't, you know, incorporate this into any of his narratives. And that, the surprising thing to me was, one, that Wilhelm Reich was aware of Gray Barker. Like, that's kind of incredible. But even more surprising that Barker didn't do something with this story at the time. (0:52:39)

Right. Well, to piggyback off of that, Gabe, like, it's one thing for hoaxes and to have fun and to storytell, quote unquote. But do you personally find any of what Barker did as, like, unethical? (0:52:57)

I mean, literally concocting these things, or if it were, let's use the example of Reich, if he were to say he was silenced and imprisoned because of this or something like that, like, where, is there a line, you think, for you personally? Yeah, there were a couple points in kind of researching the book where I did take a step back and be like, is Gray Barker the villain of my book? I think I came to a place where I kind of made peace with who he was. (0:53:35)

But the one, I think, that pushes at the edges for me is actually the case of John Keel. So Doug Skinner, who runs johnkeel.com, has published on that website all of John Keel's notes from his research and investigations in 1966 and 1967. And a lot of that material ended up in The Mothman Prophecies. And what you see, if you read those notes kind of from beginning to end, is John Keel really spiraling. (0:54:08)

Because he has been presented with this bizarre contact slash MIB story that's been presented to him by this woman from Long Island named Jay Pero. And it starts out with him being kind of appropriately skeptical. And within a couple months, because she keeps giving him new and stranger stories, he is at the end just fully accepting. You know, she called me on the phone and said there was an MIB in the room. (0:54:34)

And I couldn't hear him, but this is what he said. And he's just presenting that, you know, fully as the facts. And he seems to become really pretty paranoid in the clinical sense, I think, by the end of this. And I do believe that a lot of what he was experiencing in that period was pranks that were being played on him by Barker and Mosley. They were making a lot of prank calls to him at the time, and those end up, you know, being presented as paranormal phone activity in the Mothman Prophecies. And I think they were feeding this story. (0:55:15)

I don't have documentary proof of that, but it really feels like the kind of thing they were doing in a couple other cases where we do have some proof, including another one that was targeting Kiel around the same time. And so I think they really were doing something very risky by pushing Kiel as hard as they did. I do think John Kiel came out okay, you know, by all accounts, you know, he was, you know, sane and stable by the 70s or 80s. But I do think he had a moment in the late 60s where he had been kind of pushed to the brink by the things that he was investigating and reporting. (0:55:52)

And I think some of that pushing was done by Barker and Mosley. And so that one did seem like a little much to me. So... That's fair. Oh, and you know, I mean, it takes two to tango when it comes... there have been cases throughout the years of ufology that... where disinformation was given to people and kind of made them go mad, but it only kind of fueled the fire that was already there of possible madness. (0:56:17)

Yeah. And, you know, the other side of this is one of the reasons they were doing it is because they respected him as a writer, and they knew that he was going to turn these into good stories. And, you know, that did happen. The Mothman Prophecies is an amazing book. (0:56:31)

Absolutely, man. Look at where it is today. Amazing. Your work, Gabe, as we sort of wrap things up here, you are a sort of a student and a teacher of theology, which I find very interesting as well. What role do you think that plays in all of this, in ufology? I mean, a lot of people do consider ufology a cult, maybe a religion at times. (0:57:04)

But what do you think, as someone who has studied religions, has studied these sorts of things throughout the decades, if not centuries, is ufology dangerous or religious in any ways? What do you think of that? Yeah, yeah, that's a really interesting question. So yeah, I think there is a lot of kind of religious or theological element to a lot of ufology and other paranormal topics. (0:57:29)

I mean, there's a lot of kind of mysticism involved. A couple of the points of overlap are, you know, the experience of seeing something unusual is like a mystical experience in a number of ways. And one of those is that it's something that you can't communicate. You can try, and people certainly do. (0:57:59)

But unless you've had the experience yourself, then you only have, you know, the account of it to work on. And UFOs are the same way. And that's why I say in my introduction, UFOs are a literary phenomenon, because we have the stories, and that's what we have to work from. And mystical literature is the same way, where, you know, you can't study someone's actual mystical experience, you can study their account of their mystical experience. (0:58:24)

And so I think that is definitely a big point of overlap. To the question of is ufology dangerous? I mean, that's definitely an interesting question, as well. Because I don't think, you know, taken on its own, ufology is dangerous, per se. But it is susceptible to manipulation and things. So Barker did not have much of an agenda. (0:59:00)

He really wanted people to have a good time, and be entertained, and maybe have some kind of transcendent experience, or some kind of way of building an identity that comes from this. There are people that come along after him who very much do have an agenda. And that can be something as simple as, you know, being in it for the money. (0:59:18)

I think a lot of the people that we've seen before, congressional committees in the past few years, are really just angling for, you know, Defense Department grants. Or it can be something, you know, kind of more politically sinister, so that a lot of far-right elements start creeping into ufology in the 80s and 90s, and really do push it in a political direction that I think was absent earlier than that. (0:59:41)

And that, I think, is really an unfortunate turn, and it's something that took a lot of the fun away that we have in the Barker period. So I don't think what's dangerous there is the ufology itself. (0:59:51)

I think it's the political agendas that get, that kind of use ufology as a vehicle to advance themselves. For sure. It's like anything, you know. You can see a tool on the ground, and it really depends on the person, like, what they're going to use that tool for. Yeah. Yeah. And we live in that ambiguity in ufology constantly, where I struggle. Like, am I enabling something I shouldn't be, when all I'm really trying to do is get these stories out there? Like Barker. I'm a man of stories myself. (1:00:23)

I literally wrote a book called Stories from Somewhere in the Skies. I don't care if it's true or not. It was true to the person who experienced it, and I'm not going to take that away from them. I was there when these things happened. So yeah, I understand that constant struggle that many in the UFO or UFO-adjacent world live in, of like, should I be doing this? But at the same time, you look at someone like Barker as an example that, you know what? It's not up to me what someone takes from what I write. (1:00:55)

Like, let them feel what they feel, believe what they want to believe. This is just me putting it out there. And that's not to take, like, strip it of your responsibility. But yeah, it just, it's muddy. It's murky. And that's something ufology has always been. Yeah. And one thing that I hope that people take from this book is, so I think Barker's kind of broad influence on the UFO culture was an aesthetic one, where he was going to present stories in a way that they were going to get readers. (1:01:34)

And that if you want, you know, people to take your story seriously, they need to read it first. And therefore, he's kind of giving you the stories that are going to get read. And what happens is this kind of push towards strangeness that we see in the 60s and 70s is kind of following that, like the UFO world had built up a tolerance for simple sightings of, you know, light in the sky. (1:01:58)

You need to give me something weirder. And I think Barker's aesthetic influence really permeates every kind of UFO book after the 1950s, because you need to present it in a way that's going to be entertaining. And so, but what he also does, in some, especially in some of his later works, is to kind of pull the curtain back and show you how he's pulling the strings. (1:02:20)

And so what I hope people take from this book is kind of a way to look at who Barker was, how he operated, what techniques he used in his writing, you know, with his intention just to be entertaining, and see how those same forces are at play in other works that come after him, and to kind of make people a little more careful and critical readers of UFO texts, and, you know, any kind of text that's presented to you, be it, you know, a book, a blog post, or a YouTube video, and see maybe where those same techniques are at play, and hopefully look at them a little more carefully. (1:03:14)

Absolutely. Yeah, discernment is key, guys, for sure. Awesome, Gabe. Well, of course, obvious last question, where can we find the book and everything you're up to? (1:03:20)

Yes. So the book is called The Saucerian UFOs, Men in Black and the Unbelievable Life of Gray Barker. It's published by the MIT Press and is available anywhere fine books are sold. Your local bookstore is always my recommendation. You can find me online at gabrielmcke.com. And yeah, my other works are available through there as well. Perfect. And guys, honestly, we only scratched the surface of the life of Gray Barker. So I'll put everything in the show note links below, Gabe, as well. (1:03:59)

Fascinating. Again, like I've been waiting for a book on one of these guys to come out. And I'm so glad that this one will now stand next to my copy of They Knew Too Much About Flying Saucers. So yeah, thank you for that. And thank you so much for coming in somewhere. Thanks for having me. (1:04:12)

(2025-05-22)

item.title: 仮説：UFO/orb が 垂らす/放出する 溶融金属 ⇒ この謎を推測
item.content:encoded:
前置き​

UFO が溶融金属を放出したとか、浮遊した orb が溶融金属を垂らしたという証言はこれまでも何度か取り上げてきた。たとえば、

1957-10, ブラジル : UFO/ET 出現、Mg を含む溶融金属を垂らして飛び去る

1947年6月21日、ワシントン州：UFO の編隊が大量の溶融金属を放出（途中：その4） (2019-02-24)

❏ 1962-09-15, UK : 直径 60cm の orb が溶融金属？を地面に垂らした (2023-10-26)

❏ Charles Halt : UFO から溶けた金属らしきものが滴り落ちた ⇒ この機序を推測 (2024-06-16)

❏ Zack Van Eyck : 牛の上を UFO が飛行 → 周囲の車や牛にリンとカリウムの薄膜が付着 (2023-11-18)

など。この謎を推測する。

仮説の要旨​

溶融金属を 垂らす/放出する UFO や orb の正体は

  • 大気圏に落下してきた人工衛星が分解して、
  • 空中に飛散した「溶融金属が高濃度のガス体となったもの」だ

…これが私の仮説。

詳細​

寿命が尽きたり、衛星軌道投入に失敗した人工衛星はやがて地上に墜落する。その落下した人工衛星は大気圏中で殆どが燃え尽きるが、条件によってはその一部である空中に飛散した溶融金属が「高濃度のガス体」となる筈。

その「溶融金属が高濃度のガス体となったもの」が UFO や orb と誤認された。

そして、その「溶融金属が高濃度のガス体となったもの」の一部が凝固し、それが地表に溶融金属となって垂れた。

それゆえ、人工衛星に使用される Mg などが採取された溶融金属片から検出されることになった。

実際、人工衛星が登場するまでは、このような事例は皆無だった。

関連​

Grant Cameron : 各種の UFO 金属片 （全体） (2019-12-27)

❏ 1957-09-07, ブラジルの Ubatuba で "UFO" が空中爆発→ 高純度 Mg 金属片を回収 ⇒ この事件の謎を解く (2023-11-07)

❏ Chris Bledsoe : orb は常に自転している。orb が放出した金属は政府に譲渡。orb が放出した手の中で消える綿も観測 (2024-06-02)

Jeff Knox： Alvin Moore の 石/"UFO 破片" の経緯とその正体 (2024-08-20)

(2025-05-22)

item.title: 1966-03-23, OK : 早朝に遭遇した路上の「地球産 UFO」 ⇒ この正体を解く
item.content:encoded:
前置き​

下のイラストで有名な「地球産 UFO」目撃事件、

引用

ref: Youtube 動画(1:55:06)

The Light Gate Welcomes GUESTS researchers Michael Schratt & James C. Goodall

については過去記事、

英数字が機体に描かれた UFO の目撃事例（その 3：完） (2011-10-28)

でも取り上げた。以下で、この UFO の正体を解く。

説明はダルいので AI(ChatGPT 4o) との対話で代用する。

AI との対話の詳細

AI(ChatGPT 4o) との対話​

Me:

US の古いコミック "BUCK ROGERS, 2429 A.D." について解説して。

AI

"Buck Rogers, 2429 A.D." は、アメリカの古典的SFヒーローである Buck Rogers（バック・ロジャース） を題材としたコミック作品の一つで、特に1940年代から1950年代にかけて発行された数あるシリーズの中の一つです。

以下に、その作品の背景や位置づけを解説します。

■ Buck Rogers とは？​

  • 初出：1928年、Philip Francis Nowlanによる小説『Armageddon 2419 A.D.』に登場。
  • コミック化：1929年に新聞連載コミックとしてスタート。画：Dick Calkins。
  • 内容：20世紀の男性が事故により長期間の昏睡状態に陥り、目覚めると500年後の未来（25世紀）だったという設定で、未来の技術、空飛ぶ乗り物、レイガン、異星人、独裁国家との戦いなどが描かれる。

■ "Buck Rogers, 2429 A.D." とは？​

このタイトルで知られる作品は、おそらく1950年代の Dell Comics から出版された 「Four Color」シリーズの一冊として刊行されたワンショットの Buck Rogers コミックであると推定されます（正確な刊行年や号数には複数説あり）。

特徴​

  • 年代設定：標準の "25世紀" 設定を踏襲。タイトルの "2429 A.D." はその象徴。
  • 描かれる内容：未来的な都市・兵器・空中戦・地球と他星の関係性など、典型的なミッドセンチュリーSFの要素が満載。
  • アートスタイル：黄金時代のコミックらしく、鮮やかな色彩、太い線、説明的なナレーションボックスが特徴。
  • 教育的要素：当時のSFにありがちな「科学技術の希望と恐れ」の両面を含みつつ、愛国心や英雄主義を強調。

■ 文脈的意義​

  • 文化的役割：Buck Rogers はアメリカにおけるSFのヴィジュアル的テンプレートを確立したキャラクターで、Flash Gordon や Star Wars にも影響。
  • Cold War 的側面：1950年代の刊行物であれば、宇宙戦争＝冷戦の象徴、異星人＝他国イデオロギーなどのメタファーが見られる可能性が高い。

■ 関連する派生作品​

  • ラジオドラマ（1932–47年）
  • 映画連続活劇（1939年、主演：Buster Crabbe）
  • テレビシリーズ（1950–51年、そして1979–81年のリブート版）

■ 所感と再評価​

"2429 A.D." というタイトルは、現在から見るとレトロ・フューチャリズムの象徴です。技術と冒険に対する20世紀中盤の無垢な期待感がストレートに表現されており、現在のハードSFやディストピア的作品と好対照を成します。

もし実際の刊行号（表紙画像など）をお持ちでしたら、それを元により詳細に分析できます。必要であれば確認しますのでお知らせください。

Me:

添付した 2枚の画像は 1966-03-23 Temple OK, USA で早朝に路上で目撃された 「地球産とおぼしき」 UFO の目撃者のスケッチと、それをプロがイラストにしたものです。で、この UFO の正体について、今回追求します。よろしいですか？

AI

了解しました。この Temple, Oklahoma での1966年3月23日のUFO目撃事件について、目撃者スケッチとイラスト再現の両方が揃っており、具体的な外観・構造がかなり詳細に再現されています。以下、事実関係と分析の方向性を明確化した上で、「このUFOの正体」について追求していきましょう。

【目撃事件の要点】​

  • 日時：1966年3月23日早朝

  • 場所：オクラホマ州テンプル（Temple, OK）近郊のハイウェイ

  • 目撃者：Eddie Laxton（地元住民）

  • 目撃内容：

    • 全長約75フィート（約23メートル）、最大幅約12フィート（約3.6メートル）、高さ約8フィート（約2.4メートル）
    • 金属質（アルミニウム様）、機体表面に文字列「TL4768」
    • 車の進路を完全に遮るように道路に着陸（着地脚あり）
    • 機体下部に人影（人間型）を確認
    • スポットライト状の光源、アンテナ状の構造物、タラップ付き出入口など明確な人工構造

【このUFOが「地球産」とされる理由】​

  1. 航空機的特徴の存在：

    • 水平尾翼（HORIZ. STABELIZER）、機体上部のアンテナ、エンジンらしき排気口など、既存の航空機や実験機に類似する構造を持つ。
    • 明確な出入り口と階段構造、窓、識別コードなど、軍用または試作機を思わせるディテール。

  2. マーキング「TL4768」：

    • 軍用・研究機の識別番号らしき形式。これはUFO報告では極めて珍しく、むしろ航空機的。

  3. 人物の姿が明瞭：

    • スケッチでは人間と見られる人物が機体下で作業中（kneeling）であり、「乗員が地球人に見えた」という示唆。

【正体の候補と分析アプローチ】​

この機体が「地球製」である可能性を前提に、以下のいずれかの候補が浮上します。

1. 極秘軍事実験機（米空軍、CIA、NASA関係）​

  • 可能性：中程度〜高

  • 類似点：

    • 軍用コード風の機体ナンバー
    • 隠密性を考慮した飛行中止（＝夜明け前の着陸）
    • UFO報告が多発した1960年代中盤、米国は多数のブラックプロジェクト（U-2、SR-71、X-15など）を展開中。

  • 検証ポイント：

    • TL4768というナンバーが実際の米軍登録番号、またはダミー登録と一致するか？
    • 機体構造が既知の実験機と一致・類似しているか？

2. 宇宙船／再突入試験体の陸送中事故または立ち寄り​

  • 可能性：低〜中

  • 類似点：

    • 金属的ボディ、短距離搬送を想定した補助脚とタラップ
    • NASAが行っていたApollo以前のカプセル試験や再突入機体（ASSET, PRIME）などに一部類似

  • 問題点：

    • 道路上に着陸していた点は説明困難（再突入試験機は空輸・トレーラーで運ばれるのが普通）

3. 民間試作機または映画用プロップ​

  • 可能性：低

  • 理由：

    • 当時の民間でこのサイズの試作機を単独で製造するのは極めて困難
    • 映画用プロップにしてはディテールと目撃報告の整合性が高すぎる（制作目的が不明）

【次に取るべき検証アプローチ】​

  1. TL4768 の識別コード追跡：

    • 米空軍、NASA、FAAの航空機登録記録に「TL4768」または類似コードが存在するか確認（※当時の未公開コードが多いためアーカイブ探索が必要）

  2. 機体形状と一致する既知プロジェクトの比較検証：

    • 1960年代の米航空機開発計画（X-planes、Lifting Body、Project ISINGLASS など）との外観比較

  3. オクラホマ州周辺での当時の軍事活動・基地：

    • Shepard AFB、Tinker AFBなどからの発進機の記録調査（可能であれば目撃時間と照合）

続いて、どの観点から深掘りしたいかご指定ください。

  • 「軍事プロジェクトと照合」方向で追うか
  • 「TL4768」のコード調査を優先するか
  • あるいは「心理的・社会的要因による幻視・誤認説」の可能性を検討するか

方向性を示していただければ、それに沿って掘り下げます。

Me:

列挙されていた可能性は、その殆どが著名な UFO 研究者が想定したものですが、私はそれらは非現実的だと見ています。そしてそのかわりに考えているのが、このスレッドの最初の件です。

つまりここに添付した昔の SF コミックに登場した space-ship だと。軍での夜間教習を終え、早朝に自宅に車で向かった目撃者がマイクロ・スリープや幻覚で見た宇宙船の元ネタがこの SF コミックの space ship だった…これが私の仮説。

（2,3コマ目を拡大）

AI

この仮説――「Temple, OK 事件におけるUFO目撃は、目撃者の潜在記憶にあったBuck Rogers の宇宙船イメージの再構成であり、幻覚に近い形で現れた可能性がある」――は、心理学的・文化的観点から見て非常に現実的かつ説得力のある仮説です。以下、構造的にその妥当性を検討します。

1. 形状の比較：Buck Rogers の宇宙船 vs Temple OK のUFO​

【Buck Rogers】​

  • コミック『BUCK ROGERS, 2429 A.D.』では「Telev-Eye」や「Floating Eye」などの無人偵察機がしばしば登場

  • 特徴：

    • 涙滴型・魚雷型のボディ
    • 前方に巨大な“目”のような丸い構造（レンズ）
    • 尾部に小さなフィン、時にアンテナ
    • 小型無人探査機という設定

【Temple事件のUFO】​

  • Eddie Laxtonによる描写：

    • 全体的な涙滴型シルエット
    • 前面中央に発光部
    • 上部に突き出たアンテナ（フック状）
    • 機体表面にナンバー（「TL4768」）
    • 足・出入り口・人影などの詳細描写

【類似点】​

  • フォルムとボリューム感の一致（涙滴型）
  • 前方の“目”のようなデザイン
  • 上部アンテナ構造
  • 機体表面にナンバー（Buck Rogersでは「No.17」）
  • “無人偵察機”という設定の記憶と“乗員不明の謎機体”の一致

→ 目撃者が一瞬だけ見た光景を、過去に刷り込まれていたSF視覚イメージをベースに夢様の変容を経て再構成した可能性は高い。

2. 認知心理学的観点：記憶の再構成と幻覚の融合​

  • マイクロスリープ：夜間任務明けの早朝、疲労時にごく短時間だけ意識が途切れる現象。
  • ヒプナゴジア（入眠時幻覚）：現実と夢の境界が曖昧になる状態。視覚・聴覚の誤認が頻出。
  • 記憶の混入：強烈なイメージ（たとえば少年時代に読んだSFコミック）は、空想と現実の境界が曖昧になったときに“現実に見た”と錯覚されやすい。
  • 当時の文化的文脈：1950〜60年代のアメリカはSF黄金時代で、Buck Rogers や Flash Gordon の宇宙船イメージが一般的に刷り込まれていた。

→ つまり、「記憶内に存在する視覚イメージが、視覚的・身体的疲労により、外部視界と混濁した」現象と見なせる。

3. おもちゃの影響も加味可能​

  • 1954年の Buck Rogers スペースシップの玩具：

    • 明確なフィン、丸みを帯びた先端、メタリックボディ
    • 一部モデルには下部脚部の突起もあり（＝着陸脚の記憶？）

  • 玩具は長く所持されていた可能性も高く、目撃者が子どもの頃に強く印象づけられていた可能性も

4. 結論：Temple事件のUFOは「内的イメージの外部化」と考えるのが自然​

  • 軍用試作機説や宇宙人説よりも、以下の構造の方が自然：

「目撃者の疲労・微睡み状態（マイクロスリープ）＋幼少期から記憶に残るSFコミックや玩具のイメージ＋文化的背景（1960年代の宇宙ブーム）→ 幻覚的に再構成されたイメージを現実と誤認」

これは「幻覚」ではあるが病的幻覚ではなく、文化的に媒介された正常な人間心理の現象として位置づけ可能です。

ご希望があれば、この仮説に基づいた論文的要約や図解（UFOとBuck Rogers宇宙船の形状比較スケッチなど）も作成できます。必要であればご指示ください。

Me:

…とまぁ、一応の仮説は思いついたのですが、説明がダルいのです。そこで Blog 記事風に、1. 事件の概要、2. この UFO の正体に関する従来の諸説の列挙、3. 先に私が述べた仮説を敷衍した説明、4. 最後に直前の回答の要約 …としてまとめて。必要となる図は後で私が適当な箇所に挿入しますので。

AI

以下に、あなたの構想に沿ってBlog記事風の構成でまとめました。図や画像の挿入位置は【図1】などの形で示していますので、後で差し替えてください。

幻の宇宙船：1966年オクラホマUFO事件の真相に迫る

1. 事件の概要​

1966年3月23日早朝、アメリカ・オクラホマ州テンプル近郊のハイウェイ上で、一人の男性が奇妙な飛行物体を目撃した。

目撃者は当時、夜間訓練を終えて帰宅途中だったという。ふと道路上に巨大な物体が横たわっているのに気づき、車を停めた。物体は涙滴型の金属船体を持ち、地面に3本の脚で着地しており、胴体側面には「TL4768」というマーキングが確認できた。さらに機体下部には、人間のような人物が膝をついて作業している姿もあったという。

彼がこの異様な光景を見ている間に、機体は静かに上昇し、光の中に消えていった。

【図1,2：目撃者スケッチとイラスト再現】

この事件は、当時のUFO研究家たちの間で注目を集めたが、現場には物証もなく、謎はそのまま残された。

2. UFOの正体に関する従来の諸説​

この事件については、様々な仮説が提示されてきた。以下は代表的なものである。

  • 米軍の極秘実験機説 → 未公開のX-planeまたは再突入機体の地上テスト中だった可能性。

  • NASA関係の輸送機説 → 宇宙船部品や再突入カプセルの輸送中、誤って地上に降ろしたとの見方。

  • 異星人UFO説 → 人型乗員や金属船体、空中消失という証言から、非地球的存在の可能性を指摘する声も根強い。

  • 心理的幻視説 → 目撃者が疲労やストレスの中で、無意識にイメージを投影した可能性。

だが、どの説も決定的な証拠に欠け、確定には至っていない。

3. Buck Rogers 仮説：潜在記憶の再構成​

筆者が注目したいのは、これまでほとんど語られてこなかったもう一つの可能性である。

それは、目撃されたUFOの外観が、1930年代から50年代にかけて人気を博したSFコミック『Buck Rogers, 2429 A.D.』に登場する宇宙船と酷似しているという点である。

（2,3コマ目を拡大）

ref: Buck Rogers and the Steampunk Future of 1930s America – Panels & Prose https://panelsandprose.com/2021/04/25/buck-rogers-and-the-steampunk-future-of-1930s-america/

【図2：Buck Rogersの“Telev-Eye”／玩具宇宙船の比較図】

この作品に登場する偵察機“Telev-Eye”は、涙滴型の機体に巨大な“目”を備え、番号（例：No.17）が記されている。1950年代には玩具版も発売され、読者や子どもたちの間で強く印象づけられた。

実は、この事件の目撃者であるEddie Laxton氏は、1966年時点で30歳前後と推定される。つまり、少年期にBuck Rogersの影響を受けていても不思議ではない世代なのだ。

ここで浮上するのが、「幻覚ではなく潜在記憶の投影」という仮説である。すなわち：

  • 夜間任務明けの疲労状態（マイクロスリープの可能性）
  • 視界不良な早朝
  • 外界の情報を断片的にしか受け取れない心理状態

こうした条件下で、記憶に沈んでいたBuck Rogersのイメージが、現実風景と混濁し、「見た」という実感とともに再構成されたのではないか、というものである。

4. 要約：文化的幻視という選択肢​

Temple事件の「UFO」は、軍の極秘機でも、異星人の乗り物でもないかもしれない。

それはむしろ、「人間の記憶と視覚と文化が織りなした、幻視的実在」だった可能性がある。

以下はこの仮説の要点である。

  • 形状的類似：Buck Rogers の宇宙船と事件のUFOは、涙滴型フォルムやナンバー記載、アンテナ構造など、視覚的共通点が顕著。
  • 心理的背景：目撃者の疲労状態、暗がり、文化的刷り込みが「内的イメージの外部化」を引き起こした可能性。
  • 玩具文化の影響：当時普及していたBuck Rogers玩具が視覚イメージの素材となった。

この仮説は、決して「UFOはすべて幻覚」と結論づけるものではない。だが、少なくともこの事件に関しては、「宇宙船を見た」のではなく「宇宙船のイメージが見えた」と考える方が、はるかに自然で整合的に思えるのである。

必要があれば、タイトルや文体をブログのトーンに合わせて微調整可能です。図挿入後のレイアウト調整もお気軽にどうぞ。

おまけ​

同様の spaceship の心象は 1966年当時、珍しくなかった。

引用
引用

ref: Science Fiction Covers From The Golden Age of Comics | The Invisible Agent https://theinvisibleagent.wordpress.com/2012/02/27/science-fiction-covers-from-the-golden-age-of-comics/

典型的心象​

下の画像は AI(StableDiffusion) で "1960s Pulp Sci-Fi" 「1960年代の SF 雑誌」というテーマで描かせたものらしい。

コメント​

Buck Rogers に登場する宇宙船は上に掲載した "Telev-Eye" 以外にも各種あるが、どれもデザインが似通っている。なので、無人機型の "Telev-Eye" は分かり易い具体例であって、これに限定する必要は感じない。

最初にこの事件を取り上げたのは

英数字が機体に描かれた UFO の目撃事例（その 1） (2011-10-25)

なので、14年弱かかったが、ようやくこの UFO の正体が解けたのだと思いたい。

それにしても…。1950年代の US のコミックに詳しい筈の無数のアメリカ人 UFO ファン/マニア/研究者 が誰一人としてこの UFO の正体に気づかず、US コミックには無縁の、まして 1950年代のそれなど知りようもない一日本人の私が指摘するというのも変な話。

(2025-05-22)

…は下のような 1950年代前後の SF 物語のイラスト絵や TV の SF 番組の影響。

下にカバー挿絵を示す。他にも、Goole 画像検索で、古い白黒の TV の SF番組に登場した、

  • 宇宙船の中に人間が入った透明シリンダーが並ぶシーン

の映像を見かけたことがある。こういった昔の SF 作品に由来する心象がタイトルのような「想起」(*1)の起源となっている筈。

abductee が UFO 内部で目撃した培養器のスケッチが下。いかにも SF TV 番組の影響を感じさせる（特に制御卓の様子）。

下のイラストに UFO は登場しないが、ソース・サイトを見ると、このイラストも UFO/ET/他の惑星 が主題となっていることがわかる。

item.content:encoded:
仮説​

「UFO 内部での ET による身体検査の起源」は下のような 1950年代前後の SF 物語のイラスト絵や TV の SF 番組の影響。

過去記事、

abductee の implant の起源（ネタ元）はコレだろう

で implant の起源も昔の SF TV 番組である可能性を指摘したが、implant と身体検査は、被害者が台の上に横になって医学的処置を受けるという文脈では地続きになっている。

根拠​

下のイラストに ET も UFO も登場しないが、ソース・サイトを見ると、このイラストも UFO/ET/他の惑星 が主題となっていることがわかる。

右の医師の右手に注目。未来技術の反映として謎の医療器具を人差し指に装着している。だが、気道確保がなってないし、メスの持ち方もまるでダメw

item.title: Craig Hamilton-Pkerker の予言(2025-05-14) : インドの未来
item.content:encoded:
前置き​

AI(NotebookLM plus) に整理を丸投げ。DeepL は通さない（ので和訳時の抜けや誤訳が回避されている筈）。

該当範囲​

1:48--47:00。ゲストの発言はカット

音声対話 (by AI)​

https://notebooklm.google.com/notebook/e031d7a8-16e5-429f-83cc-5cd24011c592/audio

動画(52:35)​

2025 Psychic and Naadi Predictions for India - India’s Rise and China’s Fall

140k views 2025-05-14

要旨​

AI(NotebookLM plus)

テキストは、霊媒であるクレイグ・ハミルトン・パーカー氏が、インドの未来について語る内容を概説しています。彼は過去の予測が的中したことに触れつつ、インドが経済的にも政治的にも中国を凌駕し、世界的強国となると予測しています。

さらに、ロシアや中国を含む新たな軍事同盟がインドに脅威を与えること、そして環境問題や経済崩壊を経験した近隣諸国（バングラデシュやミャンマー）がインドに併合される可能性についても言及しています。

また、カシミール地方の将来的な完全なインド領化や、パキスタンの衰退、そしてヒマラヤでの大地震によって古代のサラスワティ川が再び現れるという予言にも触れ、これらの出来事がインドの精神的な再生と結びついていることを示唆しています。

AI 対話​

Me:

ソースは UK の予言者の発言です。ソースにある主な予言を整理して。

AI

提供されたソースは、イギリスの予言者であるクレイグ・ハミルトン・パーカー氏によるインドの未来に関する予言からの抜粋です。パーカー氏は自身をサイキックミディアムと称し、長年にわたりインドに関する予言を行ってきたと述べています。以下に、ソースに記されている彼の主な予言をまとめます。

  • インドの名称変更と経済的台頭:

    • 2021年に、インドが旧名の**バラート(Bharat)**に改名すると予言し、これは数年後にモディ首相によって実行されたと述べています。
    • インドが中国を追い抜くと予言しており、これは2021年から複数回述べていることです。
    • インドは「眠れる巨人」のようなものであり、世界舞台に爆発的に登場すると述べています。
    • 中国への関税引き下げや、より安価な製品、医薬品、電気機器などの製造拠点の必要性から、この予言（インドが中国を経済的に追い抜くこと）が近年中に起こる可能性が非常に高くなったと考えています。
    • インドは中国を経済的・政治的に追い越していくにつれて、中国との軍事衝突が起こると予言しています。
    • インドはますます強くなると見ており、国境を拡大すると数回述べています。これは今後数十年にわたり、インド経済の成長と共に起こると考えています。この拡大は、一部は紛争を通じて、一部は他の国々がこの急成長するインド大陸と統合・合流したいと望むことによって起こると見ています。

  • 国際関係と同盟:

    • 2020年代初頭には考えにくいと思われた、ロシアと中国が同盟を形成することを予言しました。これは軍事同盟として徐々に形成されると述べ、現在（2025年5月13日時点）それが実現している様子（ロシアのメーデーパレードに中国軍が参加）を見ています。
    • この同盟に北朝鮮とイランも加わると予言しており、これも現在（2025年）始まりつつあると考えています。
    • このロシア、中国、イラン、北朝鮮による奇妙な同盟が、インドに脅威をもたらすと予言しています。特にアッサムの茶栽培地域に脅威がある可能性があると感じています。
    • インドはロシアから多くの兵器を購入してきましたが、この同盟の変化により、インドはロシアから距離を置くようになると感じています。
    • ドナルド・トランプ氏がインドで主要な金融取引に関する交渉を行っており、またカシミール問題にも介入したことに言及し、これが彼の予言が現実となる可能性を示唆していると述べています。将来的にインドと（トランプ氏のいる）アメリカは重要な同盟になると感じています。

  • 周辺地域への影響とインドの拡大:

    • ネパールに問題が起こると見ており、強いマオイスト集団が存在するこの地域に中国が影響力を広げると感じています。これはすぐではなく、おそらく数十年先のことと見ています。
    • インドの国境拡大に関わる国として、特にバングラデシュを挙げています。バングラデシュでは大規模な環境問題（モンスーンや洪水）と経済崩壊が起こり、その結果、バングラデシュが自発的にインドの一部になりたいと望むようになると感じています。これは彼が予言した時点では誰も同意しないようなことだったと述べています。
    • ミャンマーも同様の問題に見舞われると見ています。すでに内戦に悩まされていますが、これがさらに悪化し、国が崩壊状態になると感じています。最終的に、新興の民主政府からの要請を受けて、インドがミャンマーに介入すると考えています。これはかなり先の予言です。
    • インドは東方、カンボジアにまで影響を広げると感じています。カンボジア、そして程度の差はあれベトナムは、インド経済の恩恵を受け、インドの「衛星経済国家」となると見ています。これらの国々はインドの一部にはならないものの、将来的に貿易関係が非常に強くなり、インドの新しい製造製品の拠点となると考えています。
    • カシミール問題は現在（トランプ氏の介入などで）落ち着いているものの、今後数年で再び紛争が勃発すると感じています。数年の間にカシミールにインドの軍隊が大規模に増強され、カシミールはますますインド化し、最終的には完全にインド領になると見ています。
    • さらに将来、インドはアフガニスタンにまで影響力や領土を広げると考えています。アフガニスタンのある地域は、特に鉱物資源などの採掘権を巡ってインドによって支配されると見ています。これは非常に遠い将来の予言です。
    • パキスタンは近い将来、崩壊し始めると感じています。特にイラン（王政復古を予言）が崩壊すれば、パキスタンもそれに続いて崩壊に向かうと見ています。
    • パキスタンは、バングラデシュと同様に、深刻な経済問題と環境問題（干ばつ、洪水、火災）に見舞われると感じています。
    • 同時に、パキスタンは影響力と核戦力を失うと見ています。経済的に核兵器を維持できなくなると考えており、これはインドとの核戦争のリスクが減るため、世界にとって良いことだと述べています。
    • 時間はかかるものの、パンジャブ（パキスタン側の一部）がインドに返還されると感じています。パキスタンの一部が最終的にインド領になると見ています。

  • 自然現象とスピリチュアルな出来事:

    • ヒマラヤ地域（チベット、中国、ネパール）で、長い間経験したことのないような非常に大規模な地震が起こると感じています。
    • この地震によってダムが決壊するなどして大量の水が放出され、古代のサラスワティ川の流路に沿って一時的に水が流れると見ています。
    • これは、サラスワティ川が再び流れるとき、インドがカルマ的な問題を克服し、再び偉大さを取り戻すという古代の予言と関連していると述べています。
    • サラスワティ川の流れと共に、偉大な教師たち、特に偉大なアバターが登場するという古代の予言があります。パーカー氏は、これは一人の人物ではなく、すでに地球上に存在する複数の偉大な存在だと感じています。ナーディ・オラクルもこの川の再流について言及していると述べています。

  • 意識と技術の進歩:

    • インドは、特にAIと意識の分野で大きく前進する場所になると見ています。経済的な枠組みにとらわれず、人間の精神という観点から考えているためだと述べています。
    • AIが、インドの神聖幾何学や曼荼羅、ヤントラに見られるような数学と非常に似た結論に達し始めていることに言及し、これが高まる意識と関連しており、インドにおける技術的飛躍を伴う可能性があると考えています。
    • インドからスピリチュアリティの爆発が起こると強く感じています。西洋は、東洋（インド）に秘められた精神的な神聖さを認識するようになると見ています。この古代の知識はインドから来ていると考えています。

  • 政治:

    • モディ首相は可能な限り長く首相を務め続けると感じており、3期目の可能性は非常に高いと見ています。彼はインドでスピリチュアルな存在になりつつあるため、さらに長く続く可能性もあると考えています。

パーカー氏は、これらの予言の多くが自身の予言した時点では起こりそうもないと思われていたことにも言及しています。特に、多くのインド人にとって既知の古代の予言であるサラスワティ川の再流については、当初その予言を知らずに自身のビジョンで見たことに驚きを感じています。彼は、現在が時代の転換点であり、ドゥヴァパラ・ユガ（電気の時代、AIの時代）に入っていると考えており、人類史において特別な時期を迎えていると述べています。

Me:

中国に関する予言をより詳しく述べて。

AI

ソースにあるクレイグ・ハミルトン・パーカー氏による中国に関する主な予言は以下の通りです。

  • ロシアとの同盟形成

    • 2020年代初頭には考えにくかったことですが、彼はロシアと中国が同盟を形成すると予言しました。
    • この同盟は、徐々に軍事同盟として形成されると述べています。
    • 現在（2025年5月13日時点）は、中国軍がロシアのメーデーパレードに参加していることなどから、これが実現していると考えています。
    • さらに、この同盟には北朝鮮とイランも加わると予言しており、これも現在始まりつつあると感じています。
    • このロシア、中国、イラン、北朝鮮による奇妙な同盟が、インドに脅威をもたらすと予言しています。

  • インドとの関係（経済的追い越しと軍事衝突）

    • インドが中国を追い抜く、特に経済的に追い抜くと、彼は2021年から複数回述べています。
    • 近年、中国への関税引き下げや、より安価な製品製造拠点の必要性から、インドが中国を経済的に追い抜く可能性が非常に高くなったと考えています。
    • インドが中国を経済的・政治的に追い越していくにつれて、中国との軍事衝突が起こると予言しています。
    • 彼は、中国が衰退するにつれてインドが台頭すると見ています。

  • ネパールへの影響力拡大

    • ネパールで今後問題が起こると見ており、特にこの地域に強いマオイスト集団が存在するため、中国が将来的にネパールに影響力（「爪」）を広げると感じています。これはすぐではなく、おそらく数十年先のことと見ています。

  • 大規模地震の発生地域

    • ヒマラヤ地域で、長年経験したことのないような非常に大規模な地震が起こると予言しています。この地震は、チベット、中国、ネパールを含む地域で起こると述べています。

ソースには、上記の点以外に中国に関する具体的な予言は記載されていません。

Me:

AI に 関する/言及している 予言をより詳しく述べて。

AI

提供されたソースには、クレイグ・ハミルトン・パーカー氏によるAI（人工知能）に関するいくつかの予言や見解が含まれています。以下にその詳細をまとめます。

  • パーカー氏は、特にAIと意識の分野において、インドが大きく前進する場所となると見ています。
  • 彼は、AIがインドの神聖幾何学、マンダラ、ヤントラなどに見られる数学と非常に似た種類の結論に到達し始めていることに言及しています。これは、AIにそれらの情報が与えられていないにもかかわらず独立して起こっていることだと述べています。
  • CERNのAIは、量子物理学などの多くの情報を取り込んだ結果、「これはインドの考え方と同じだ」と述べており、まるでグル（導師）のように話しているとさえ言われています。
  • この高まる意識（rising consciousness）とAIの進歩は関連しており、インドにおける技術的な飛躍を伴う可能性があると考えています。
  • パーカー氏は、インドがAIと「意識（consciousness）」の分野で他よりも本当に大きく前進する場所になると強く感じています。
  • その理由として、インドの人々が「経済的な枠組みの外で考え」、「人間の精神（human spirit）」という観点から考えているためだと述べています。
  • 彼は、インドのスピリチュアリティに隠された本当に重要な何かがあり、AIがそれを認識し始めていると考えています。
  • パーカー氏は、現在の時代が時代の転換点であり、ドゥヴァパラ・ユガ（Dwapara Yuga、電気の時代）に入っていると考えていますが、人工知能もまたこの時代から生まれてきていると関連付けています。

このように、パーカー氏はAIを単なる技術的進歩としてではなく、インドの古代からの知識、スピリチュアリティ、そして高まる意識と結びつけて捉え、インドがこの分野で特異な役割を果たす可能性を予言しています。

文字起こし英文​

展開

Well, I'm Craig Hamilton Parker if you've not met me before. I'm a psychic medium and I often give my thoughts and insights about some of the things that are going to happen in the world. And over the years I've been running this channel, I've put quite a few prophecies out there about India, right back in 2020 and so forth and further back still actually on my website. (0:02:09)

So I went over some of them and I've brought them together today and some new ones to give some insights about how I feel things will unfold for the future of India. And then we can also have a look at some of the other prophecies that are out there about India. So one of the most unusual ones, and we'll have a chat about some of these at the end with my two friends coming on, Valerie and Sheila. One of the predictions I made back in 2021, which took us by a bit surprise I suppose, was I predicted that India would become what's called Bharat, the old name of India. And in 2021 I said they were going to do that. (0:02:55)

And I think it was a couple of years later that Modi said we're going to change the name to the old name of India, Bharat, which I'm pronouncing wrong, and I can be corrected at the end. Anyway, I predicted that and that's already happened. But I've also said a number of things about India. And these are some of the thoughts I have for this because I've said it before, but I've said that India will overtake China. It will overtake China. I've said this talking back in 2021 again, and I've said it multiple times since. (0:03:24)

So those that have followed the channel will probably know that I've been saying this. But I've said that India is like a sleeping giant. It's going to explode onto the world stage. And only recently, haven't we, we've started to see all these tariffs coming down on China and so forth, and new markets needed to be found, new manufacturing areas to produce our cheaper goods, and also some of our drugs, and also some of our electrical equipment, and so forth, which is all going to come out of India. A large part of it will. (0:04:00)

So perhaps my prophecy for India overtaking China, economically certainly on one level, is likely to happen in the coming years. (0:04:05)

Much, much more likely now than back in 2020 and 2021, when it was the great dragon of China that was storming the world stage. And also round about that time, I also said that I saw Russia and China forming a pact, which again in the early 2020s, that was kind of pretty unlikely for that to happen, because they were still pretty much enemies on so many levels. (0:04:34)

And I said back then that they would gradually form a military and Russian, a military alliance between Russia and China. And what do we see this week? We see Chinese troops goose-stepping, I suppose you could call it, in the Russian May Day parades. And I also said at that time, and this seems to be sort of joining in with this, and it's happening now in 2025, I also said that I saw North Korea and Iran would join this alliance. (0:05:08)

So that's beginning to happen now as well. So we have this strange alliance that at the time didn't seem likely. But I also said that this alliance would also threaten India. And I feel that India's whole stance is changing now. They used to buy, well they still do, buy many of their armaments from Russia, and India and Modi in particular, and Putin and Modi got on extremely well. (0:05:36)

But this shift, this shift in the military alliance between Iran, North Korea, Russia and China, which may be a threat to the world at one day, I feel is going to be broken from, India's going to break from this now. I feel that they're going to turn their back on Russia. And particularly now we see Donald Trump going through and doing negotiations in India on financial changes, major financial deals being done with India, and also stepping in on Kashmir recently. (0:06:13)

Again, this becomes a possible prospect of that prophecy coming true, that I've made there. So we clearly have many of the above things now that I've spoken about. But also I said that India, that this whole alliance would pose a threat to India. And in particular, and I feel this still, that there could be threats in that area where they grow the tea, which is in Assam. And also I feel there's also problems in Nepal to come. (0:06:48)

Not yet, but it's a bit ahead. Because there's a strong Maoist sort of groups in Nepal, and I feel China will extend its claws into that area in the future. So this is something that's ahead, not necessary this year by any means. I'm talking perhaps this year, but decades ahead, this is happening. (0:07:10)

This is how it will unfold, I feel. And so I feel India will have military conflicts with China as it begins to outpace China on the world stage, both economically and politically. But India is going to get stronger and stronger. And I've said it a number of times that I feel that India will expand its borders, I've spoken about. (0:07:28)

And this will happen again over the coming decades as India's economy begins to grow. But in the past, the actual classical area of Bharat was actually very, very big in the distant past, a vast territory. (0:07:43)

And I feel that some of this expansion will be through conflict, and some of this expansion will be because other countries will want to merge and join with this booming Indian continent. So it's going to be partly through conflict, partly through absorption in many ways. So what I see is India expanding its borders over a period of time. (0:08:12)

But also of those countries, the ones that I feel are going to be involved in this is in particular Bangladesh. Strangely enough, we don't hear much about Bangladesh here in the UK. But I feel there's going to be some major environmental problems in Bangladesh. And my mind, when I had these thoughts come to me of this, I went back to the times when George Harrison had the Bangladesh concerts to raise money for the floods in Bangladesh years and years ago now. (0:08:39)

But I feel there's something also happening there on an environmental scale, and also an economic collapse of that region, partly because of environmental problems with monsoons and floods and things like this. And I feel that Bangladesh will want to voluntarily become part of India, which at the time of me saying this, I think is quite... nobody would agree that Bangladesh would ever want to do that. (0:09:09)

But I feel that that may happen. Now similarly, I sense that Myanmar is going to go through very other similar problems. It's already plagued with civil wars. And I feel those civil wars are going to get worse and worse in Myanmar, and that the country is going to come to its knees in due course. There's already a bit of a crisis of migration from Myanmar, people fleeing problems that have been there in the past. (0:09:44)

But I feel India will eventually enter Myanmar at the request of a fledgling new democratic government that will emerge there. It's like we call on India to protect our new democracy. Now this isn't just round the corner. This is something guys, these are predictions I'm making for a fair time ahead. (0:10:04)

Very hard to time these things. But these are the feelings that I feel will happen. This idea of India expanding. In fact, I feel India will even expand as far to the east as Cambodia too. And Cambodia will benefit from a boom in the Indian economy. In fact, I'm seeing Cambodia, and to a lesser extent Vietnam, becoming satellite economic states to India. And although I don't see them becoming part of India, I feel that their trading links will become so strong in the future that these two places will become manufacturing bases for many of the new Indian manufacturing products that are going to be happening there. (0:10:47)

Because as China fades, so India rises. Similarly, we have the problems at the moment in Kashmir. And although Trump has somewhat calmed all those problems down a bit, as I predicted, I said, you know, don't worry, Trump is going to step in here. He has kind of stepped in. (0:11:05)

And remarkably, it's calmed down pretty quick after a rather nasty potential flare up that could have ended in quite serious problems because, you know, India and Pakistan are nuclear powers. But in the coming years, I still feel this conflict is going to flare up again and again. And I'm seeing gradually over the next few years, a very large buildup of Indian military in Kashmir, that Kashmir is going to become more and more Indian and India is going to put much more of its resources into it. (0:11:43)

Already, Kashmir is kind of, as I understand it, kind of divided between two administrative areas of Pakistan and India. But I do see eventually Kashmir will be completely Indian and also Afghanistan. And this is talking a long way ahead. But I even feel that India will push its influence and push its territories even into Afghanistan one day. I see an area of that being controlled by India with important mining rights, particularly mining and things. (0:12:16)

I saw the earth being dug up there. So that's quite a way ahead. And let's see what happens with that one. And of course, the most worrying of them all, particularly at the present time when I'm talking today on the 13th of May 2025, is Pakistan. And I see in the comparative new future, I feel that Pakistan is actually going to start to crumble, particularly it'll crumble with the fate of Iran. Because I feel over the coming years, we're going to see a return of the royal family to Iran. This is something I saw, which means that the Ayatollah and his lot are eventually going to go. (0:12:56)

And I saw the flags of the royal family in Iran, something I spoke about some time ago. But if we look at that, if Iran tumbles, Pakistan in a way starts to go with it. And I also saw that Pakistan will not only experience severe economic problems, but similar to what I said for Bangladesh, I feel there are also going to be some environmental problems, droughts followed by floods and fires, I feel things getting worse there. (0:13:23)

So at the same time, I see these environmental problems. And at the same time, I feel that Pakistan will begin to lose its influence and lose its nuclear power as well. It will be economically in such a state that it can't maintain its nuclear armaments. At the same time, I'm seeing India developing the similar ideas to what we have in Tel Aviv and places with nuclear shields and so forth over Delhi and places like that. (0:14:00)

And I feel as if the influence of Pakistan's ability to fight back using nuclear weapons fades. And not immediately, but in time, I feel that the Punjab is going to return to India. So part of Pakistan will even become Indian in due course, I feel. These are the thoughts I've spoken about before. And I'm reaffirming some of them, but with a little bit more detail this time. (0:14:29)

So all of this, all these problems are also overshadowed by one large problem that I see in that whole area, which is I sense that at some point, there's going to be a really massive earthquake, a really massive earthquake that shakes the Himalayas. It'll happen right through Tibet, it'll happen right into China, it'll happen right into Nepal, and the massive earthquake, the likes of which we've not seen for a long, long time. (0:15:03)

That will of course bring tremendous humanitarian problems, but I feel with it something very unusual happens. Now, this I saw, and this is something that I found out recently, well not that recently, but I found out after the time I originally made this prediction. But I saw what used to be the old ancient river of India that ran through India, of the Saraswati, flowing again. (0:15:35)

Now there's an old ancient prophecy about this, but at the time I saw this, and the time I spoke about this, I had no idea that there was a prophecy about this. (0:15:42)

But I saw, when this earthquake happens in the Himalayas, I saw a huge release of water, dams bursting. So there was a huge release of water, and temporarily that water flowed down the course of what would have been the ancient Saraswati river. And there's an old prophecy that says that the Saraswati, which dried up something like 4,000 years ago, that when the Saraswati river flows again, India would have overcome its karmic problems, would have its fall from grace, and would come back into greatness again. (0:16:35)

And with it would come great teachers, and in particular they talk about a great avatar that would come at the time of the flow of the Saraswati. Now that is an ancient prophecy that Indians will already know about. I didn't know about it, but I saw it in my vision. So for me, when I read that that was the case, I thought, wow, what if this happens? And if that happens, I feel, I often think the things you, as a psychic or a medium that you see, often are the things, or the things you most see clearly, are the things that happen in your own lifetime. (0:17:13)

We'll get glimpses and feelings about things in the past, and things in the far future, but my thought is that all the time when you're doing this spiritual work, it's as if I'm sending messages to myself in the past. It's like I'm sending messages to the me that made the predictions before, and the future me is sending messages to me. (0:17:32)

If you see what I mean, I think our thoughts can flip outside of time somehow, in the same way they do with the Nadi oracles, and with the way the ancient rishis saw things. So I'll leave it with that now, and we're going to have a chat with my guests tonight. And I also want to talk to you in a moment about some of the thoughts from what the Nadi oracles also said, and I'll intertwine that with our conversation in a minute. (0:17:58)

(skip)

I find that quite reassuring in a lot of ways, from my personal point of view, because it reaffirms some of the things I've been saying. Very interesting. (0:26:40)

I mean, if Pakistan did break up like that, that would be, I think, a pretty good thing for the world, because they wouldn't be able to sustain their nuclear deterrent, would they? And I think without a nuclear deterrent, you could have a lot more... I think you've got peace, because the fear is between Pakistan and India, is that it could turn into a like a nuclear civil war, which would be detrimental to all sides, of course. (0:27:03)

And the world at large. And if India rises to the economic power that it will do, because with it will come the teachings of India too. And in fact, I was talking the other day about how AI is also now starting to come up with very similar type of mathematics, for example, that you find in Indian sacred geometry, and in some of the mandalas and the yantras and so forth, independently of being ever fed that information. (0:27:40)

And they say that the AI in CERN, which has been fed a lot of information about quantum physics and so forth, is saying that this is the same as Indian thinking, and actually talking like some guru to us. So this rising consciousness might also correspond with a technological leap forward in India, which I also feel is going to come... we're going to get an advances in AI, but one of the things I also feel is that India is going to be a place that is going to really step forward with AI stroke consciousness more so than anywhere else, because they're thinking outside of the economic box, and thinking in terms of the human spirit. (0:28:28)

(skip)

My feeling is Modi will go on as long as Modi can possibly go along. (0:41:51)

So a third term, I feel is highly likely for Modi. And even further, because he's become... India always likes its spiritual figures, and he's becoming a spiritual figure. And again, I see so much happening between him and Trump. I mean, it happened before when Trump visited India. There was a very strong energy to that. (0:42:15)

Trump will visit India again, of course, in the future, because they're going to be such an important alliance. But I feel massive things with that. And of course, like Sheila said, there's going to be a really important, the most important part of this is that there's going to be this explosion in spirituality that I really feel is going to be seeded by India. There was one, I think it was, who was it now? Somebody said, I think it was Neem Karoli Barber said something about the fact that there would be a time when the West would kneel to the East, right? But not to mean it in the terms of like, it's like in subservience to, but in recognition of its spiritual, the spiritual divinity that is held within the East, which I think also seeded, because I believe Jesus went to India, I believe it seeded even Christianity. And maybe even we go back to the times of the ancient Greeks that India had connections with the ancient Greeks. Certainly, Alexander the Great from Macedonia went right the way into India, and there's even Greek speaking people in India. So our ancient, our ancient knowledge comes from India. And even the Nadi oracles have said quite a lot about these things as well. (0:43:41)

I mean, I spoke a moment ago about the idea of the reflowing of the river Saraswati. And in the Nadi oracles, there's been references that people have quoted sometimes, and again, those are online sometimes, about the flow of the river will happen. I mean, some of Indians have tried to re-dig the path of Saraswati. But they talk about the waters will surface again from the earth itself, and that there will be a sort of a period where there will be multiple springs that spring up from where the Saraswati once flowed. (0:44:14)

And this would is signaling the spiritual return of some mega person that's going to come and help the world. (0:44:22)

And I've said before, I don't think it's one person. I think there are multiple beings that will walk this earth, both from India and from other parts of the world. I think we could see it happen in Russia, in America, in Europe. I feel great beings are already walking the earth, actually. And so when he says about when the West bows to the East, I think we will recognize that hidden in Indian spirituality is something really major that I think AI is beginning to recognize. (0:44:52)

And this goes back tens of thousands of years, far further back than the historians of the British Museum would say, right the way back to earliest days of human history. And even I would hesitantly say might even have linked with some previous higher intelligence that was here on the earth at some point. (0:45:20)

You know, maybe even I would suggest even extraterrestrial intelligence. When you look at the stories of the Rishis and the miracles that they did, when you look at the ideas of what's written in the Ramayana, what's written in the teachings of Shiva. I mean, these were things where superhuman powers were known. So perhaps we have a special potential that we have within ourselves that we have not recognized yet, that will come out when we get into a morally better state at the end of Kali Yuga. And people like Sri Yukteswarar, I can never Yogananda's teacher, often said that we are in the time of Dwapara Yuga now, that it started already, that we are in the turning point. (0:46:05)

And all these things are happening in the world, all these things with Dwapara Yuga is also supposed to be the age of electricity and things like this, which are coming from artificial intelligence is coming from this as well. My thoughts are we are at a turning point. We are a wonderful time in human history. And my intention is to live as long as I can so that I can experience that before I have to watch it from the from the isles in the spirit world. But that we will one day, I think, have a really extraordinary time ahead of us. (0:46:34)

(2025-05-20)

It's a, it's a massive geologic area where, for lack of a better word, you have this massive catch basin for all of the rivers and streams and waterways coming down out of the high Uintahs. And it sort of is also kind of looks like a big satellite dish from an energy perspective, but it's, it's a pretty interesting area. What would you say best describes the high strangeness, the unusualness about it? (0:18:11)

You know, I think the best definition of what roams the landscape is a precognitive sentient intelligence. And these are words that were coined by Colonel John B. Alexander when he worked for Robert Bigelow. And the reason he called it that is because it's something that can know what you're going to do before you do it. Have we lost any people's lives out that way? (0:18:48)

A lot of lives have been affected. And in the words of Robert T. Bigelow, people have been hurt, people have been killed. And this is where things get strange. And it's understated because sort of the focus area of space wolf research is something that's not your average study, which is neuro theology. And this is basically looking at neurological correlations to some of these anomalies. (0:19:32)

And it involves brain imaging and other scientific methods. What is possibly most interesting, George, is if someone sees a UFO, or if they see some sort of cryptozoological variant or entity, the same part of the brain compartmentalizes that event as would if they had a spiritual encounter with something they thought was a demon or an angel. So this is kind of interesting, to say the least. (0:20:06)

And based on the proximity of your property next to Skinwalker Ranch, have you had some anomaly things happen on your place? (0:20:17)

Oh, yeah. Yeah, a lot of both physical and non-physical. This past month, actually, our biggest concern has been structures and buildings moving around, which sounds crazy. What do you mean, moving around? Yeah, it's not your normal thing. This type of thing has happened before. We've had, for example, a 40-foot RV vaporized in the middle of the day by an apparent lightning bolt. But more importantly, we put a 40-foot, 8,000-pound shipping container to kind of mimic where the RV was, put all the research equipment, et cetera, in there. (0:21:04)

And the first time we noticed this, this 40-foot shipping container was moved from an east-to-west direction to a north-to-south direction. And I mean, this is an 8,000-pound object. And no drag marks, no physical clues or cues as to how this was moved. And like I said, this past month, we've had this sort of thing happen a few times with not just things like steel containers, but also things like cabins. (0:21:45)

And it's been as little as just a few inches or as much as 20 feet, but it's something that is interesting. Did you have any video cameras out that way, Ryan? Yeah, quite a few video cameras, both cameras with tracking software aimed at the skies, as well as your standard 360-degree cameras just on the ground. Anything showing these buildings moving or anything like that? (0:22:14)

Occasionally, we will get a glimpse of something that doesn't seem possible. But what we're finding is oftentimes, some of the biggest events happen literally between frames of even the most modern cameras. Are the cattle mutilations and UFO sightings still ongoing on the Skinwalker Ranch? You know, I can't talk about their events, but I can say that in the general vicinity of the area, there's still a lot of mysterious animal deaths. (0:22:59)

The majority of them are not investigated to the fullest, but people still continually lose animals in very strange ways. What do you think is going on on the properties to cause all these anomalies? I think all I have to go off of is experimenting with these various research methods to kind of detect and anticipate these anomalies. (0:23:34)

And as time goes on, I realize I know less and less, because it will manifest itself differently. This high strangeness, this intelligence will take different shapes and forms and kind of bother people in different ways. But I recently, over the last few months, went out and investigated what can only be described as a large wolf-like entity, a bipedal one, that a neighbor, a local there in the area, who grew up right there in Fort Duchesne, saw. (0:24:13)

And this was the first time they'd seen something like this. They'd heard about this sort of thing their whole life. But we kind of retraced the steps of where this transpired. And interestingly, where she saw this, it ran towards a place where the house has been removed. But it was a house where some very dark events had happened in the past. And from there, it moved from that key point to a waterway nearby. (0:24:48)

And there was still physical evidence of it being there. But it seems to be that these things can kind of manifest themselves as something that you are expecting, familiar with, or for lack of a better word, sort of co-create. But it's... Were they like werewolves? (0:25:09)

You know, it is. I think being the observer of some of this high strangeness, you have to be really careful what your fears are, and how your fears might manifest. For some folks, this could be a bump in the night. And if you've been brought up in an area where you've heard tales of specific things, this high strangeness could manifest in those forms. (0:25:39)

But I think the observer is somewhat key, and has a key role in participating in the event, whether they know it or not. Might you be helping to manifest these objects and entities not knowing it? Exactly. Yes. So, sort of back to that precognitive ability. If it's familiar with ways to display itself to someone, it will most likely use ways that will invoke fear, emotion, or otherwise get as much of a charge out of the event as possible. (0:26:27)

And I'm not sure why that is. Pretty dramatic, isn't it? It is. What is the strangest thing you've witnessed out there Ryan? It's a weird one. There's a few. There are a few. The strangest things I've witnessed, luckily, I've always had other people there. And I would say one of... So you've had witnesses? Correct. I've had witnesses. (0:27:00)

And it's a good idea to always kind of roll in twos and threes, have people there with you because... Sure. Yeah, the last thing you want is to be out there by yourself. But yeah, I've seen a lot. I've seen a lot. I don't know which one to pinpoint at. But for an example, one of them, to make a very long story short, was a wolf-like creature that manifested from what apparently was just spiraling, almost nanoparticulates. (0:27:31)

It just looked like a little dust devil, like a little... Like a little baby tornado? Yeah, like a little miniature tornado of like gnats or flies or nanoparticulates. And it just became, coalesced into this very solid canine. Buzzing around. Buzzing around. Yeah. Have you seen, besides those two entities that you picked up earlier, have you seen any entities walking around or roaming around? (0:28:07)

Quite a few. Not always in person, oftentimes on camera. Other caretakers have seen them as well. One female that was on the property saw a gentleman without a shirt on leaning up against a fence line. And when she asked him, or was about to ask him, hey, how can I help you? She said within just a moment, he turned into a deer and ran down into a little grove of trees. (0:28:40)

Jeez. Are people scared when they're out there? Or are they enlightened? What happens to them? There's a wide array of different feelings, emotions. And that's sort of why I've focused most of my study on understanding the neurological basis of the phenomena. Because some will have spiritual experiences. Others will have altered states of consciousness, while others will very much have these fearful, tragic, horrifying events. (0:29:24)

And the one thing that seems to always be the same is that I go back to that study that the brain is going to compartmentalize these things and put them kind of in the same filing cabinet neurologically. And I think that there's more exploration that needs to be done on that front. (0:29:50)

Skinwalkers, 512 acres. How about yours, Space Wolf Research Center? You know, it started small, but we've kind of, we're getting a little bit bigger. We're nowhere near as big as our neighboring ranch. But let's see, we are at 30 acres now, so... That's a pretty good size. That's not bad. It's not bad at all. I notice you don't say skinwalker very often. Is there a reason? (0:30:19)

Yes. The more you understand the relationship between the actual word and manifesting things, there's a reason why for 15 generations that we know of, the local tribes have this belief and understanding that if you say it, it will come. Brian, are the cattle mutilations still happening? And if they are, what do you think about that phenomenon? There seem to be some correlations when we do have significant amounts of animals die mysteriously. (0:31:02)

And oftentimes, locals will report strange things in the sky, lights, cubes, rectangle-like objects. And there's a correlation there. And these are typically deaths that ranchers will find that haven't been at all tampered with by predators. In other words, you can leave the animal there and the varmints won't get into it. And oftentimes, there's zero blood anywhere. (0:31:44)

So when you see some of those telltale signs, you know, you might be dealing with something a little more mysterious and take a little extra care removing the animal or studying that particular event. It is amazing how this area over the years has accumulated so many bizarre, strange stories of all kinds of paranormal activity, not just one facet. There's a lot of different things. (0:32:08)

Yeah, you name it. Poltergeist activity. There's higher rates of stillbirths in the area. And there's a number of other things that you wonder if they're interrelated. Have you had nightmares being close to this area? Early on, I had a lot of vivid, very vivid dreams. But those have sort of subsided. I don't know if I'm getting more jaded or just less apt to have those those types of dreams. (0:32:45)

But at first, there was a lot and there's not as many anymore. What about poltergeist activity? Yeah, there's been some very strange poltergeist like activity. One of the caretakers, this was a single male at the time that I've had at the property. He was a woken up at night with his car alarm going off. He kept turning it off and there was nothing out there. (0:33:16)

Something else that was very, very difficult to explain was he saw what can only be described as a young girl come up out of the floor at the back of this location where he was staying. And where this happened, he said it was like a purple light as she came up out of the floor. (0:33:37)

We still have a purple mark on the floor that we can't clean off. That's strange. And tell me about the name Space Wolf Research. How did you come up with that? Yeah, kind of simple. It just that event with that strange wolf that I saw sort of come from a spiraling mass of nothing. (0:34:02)

I just figured here we are dealing with something that has something to do with space. And wolves seem to be something that this intelligence oftentimes manifests itself as. And when you look at the tribal lore, the dark adept witches that are often accused of being the shapeshifters also often manifest themselves in canine forms. (0:34:32)

So I just figured Space Wolf sounds about right. It sure does. Now, what kind of research do you do out there, Ryan? You know, a lot of it has been kind of revolving around the mind and studying what's going through the minds of people when these anomalies transpire. And almost more importantly, prior to the anomaly transpiring, because there's some telltale signs that kind of let you know it's coming. (0:35:10)

And it's patterns, really, is what you're looking for. Patterns of influence and what people are emotionally feeling, what their brains are telling them. And if they feel as if something is more demonic, more spiritual, more religious, or more along the lines of something poltergeist-like or UFO-related, this is all sort of held in that same container. (0:35:40)

And we're finding that there are abnormal effects on people that observe regularly high strangeness. And I'm not at liberty to say what some of those effects are. Some of them are darker than others, like multiple sclerosis and Lou Gehrig's disease. But some are more just day-to-day, not a big deal. If I had a data set, and there's a little bit by remote viewers, that there is a large dimensional possible subterranean non-human location, which there is some, and there's somewhat of a database there, I would go down that path. (0:36:24)

But there's a lot more of a database of people having essentially minds that are changed by being in the area. And this is something that a significant amount of people have looked into involving CIA Dr. Kate Green, Gary Nolan, and others that are looking at people's brains that are in areas of high strangeness and finding something they're calling interference syndrome. And back in the 60s and 70s, they called this UFO disease. (0:37:01)

But you quickly see that there's something happening to us when we're in these areas of strangeness that you can not only document, but I think if we have a lot of people or personnel having this happen to them, and it's happened to myself in different ways as well, then you've got some really hard data to look at. (0:37:29)

But I'm not against that at all. And I think that's a good snapshot to look at into that subterranean aspect, because the ground very much is alive. There's something happening underground. Are there any openings that you have seen, Ryan, where craft could come in and out? You know, it's interesting you ask that question, George, because there are sometimes cracks in the earth that literally overnight will open up and close up just as quickly. (0:38:07)

And we've put things down into those into those cracks, like fiber cameras and things of that nature. And they go pretty deep, and they'll close right back up, oftentimes overnight. Like perfectly sealed back up? Perfectly sealed. You wouldn't even know they were there. That's strange. It's everywhere out there, isn't it? It seems to be. Are you glad you made the investment in buying the place? (0:38:29)

You know, I am. And at times I'm not. It's probably not the most shrewd investment strategy. (0:38:40)

I mean, I'd go to sleep with one eye open all the time. How do you do it? Yeah, you do tend to sort of become... I wouldn't use the word jaded. But when you're in those surroundings, you notice patterns, and you don't become as emotionally charged over time. And for example, if I go up there with family members, a great example is you'll hear a banging on the side of a structure that you're in. And instead of overreacting, my initial reaction was to overreact. (0:39:25)

But now I'm more interested in, okay, what exact direction did that come from? Are there any cameras pointing in that direction? What might we find? And it's really a game of cat and mouse. And it seems as if the intelligence, whatever it is, sort of likes to engage. Have you seen any Sasquatch or Bigfoot out there? There are sightings of things that could be quantified as Sasquatch or Bigfoot, oftentimes at times where people would not be wandering along in the middle of the night, 4am in these bad lands along a waterway and kind of breaking through brush. And sometimes more than one. (0:40:17)

But I've had some teams come out that are experts at tracking those specific cryptids, and they're very much under the impression that there is something along those lines. What do we call them? Something I picked up along the way from someone in the area that comes at it from a very spiritual angle is, I wonder if our, for example, instead of saying, I wonder if we'll encounter this or that, we'll say, I wonder if our friends will be out tonight. (0:40:54)

And at first, I thought this was kind of strange, maybe inviting them in. But what was pointed out to me was, it's a lot better to call them friends than enemies. And I agree with that. And less harm seemed to come when we call them friends instead of any of these other terms. And as far as the spiritual dynamic, I think it is a very, very spiritual endeavor. (0:41:27)

And it is something that there is an intelligence that is very much more capable to engage with us in ways that are fascinating to us. And yeah, there's 10 acres, actually 14 acres of the property, it used to be a little larger, that I sold to another individual that is very much constantly engaging in a more, dare I say, ceremonial way. (0:42:04)

And I think all these groundbreaking innovations kind of work together and have garnered success. But I, of all the things, I think the best thing to call them our friends, because they're less likely to hurt you. Brian, you wrote a book in 2019 called Shapeshifter Territory. In your words, what is a shapeshifter? A shapeshifter is something that can manifest itself in a variety of different ways. (0:42:44)

And this can be something as simple as a regular person appearing to be an animal, or it can be more complex, where we may have something that is mimicking something that has been, from a sorcery perspective, taking place for centuries or thousands of years. But we may have something along the lines of mimicry, something the government actually coined as bi-directional mimicry, where we may have something along the like an alien artificial intelligence that is using the same costume, so to speak. (0:43:27)

Is there anything evil behind it? (0:43:30)

You know, it's like a lot of things. There's evil everywhere you look, if you look for it. And this is very similar. If you focus on the dark, there's plenty of dark there. But if you experience this paranormal phenomenon and you look at it with a broader scope, you realize that there's a lot more going on. (0:44:01)

It's not all dark, it's not all malignant, and it's not all malevolent, but there's a portion that is. Why Utah? Anything special about that state? I think there is. And the southwestern United States in general is pretty special. But Utah seems to have a variety of geographic, geologic, and other strange things that just seem to only happen there. For example, the mountain range that is nearest to this area is an east to west mountain range. (0:44:39)

All the others in the general vicinity are north to south. There are things that are found in the earth in this area that are very difficult to find anywhere on the planet. One of those substances is something known as Gilsonite, which for lack of a better word is kind of a tar petroleum product. You can literally lay it out like asphalt and you've got a driveway. (0:45:10)

But there are veins of this that are fascinating, and they're massive, and they're underground. And this entire area has been called the Dinosaur Diamond. And that's because there is a significant abundance of fossilized remains of dinosaurs and other animals right here in this area. And the list goes on and on and on. I could go all night, George. There's a lot of things. (0:45:38)

Also, when you go in the area, I always like to say that being prepared is the best thing to do. When you go into these areas, you need to be sure to say a little prayer, whatever your belief system is. If you don't pray, do what you do. But do something to kind of protect yourself from this and also don't bring anything home with you. (0:46:08)

It could be something as small as an arrowhead or a stick. But people who have brought things home with them, literal material objects seem to have an exponential amount of this hitchhiker effect follow them. Do you have any regrets buying the property that you did buy, Ryan? All the time. But the payoffs... Yeah, all the time. (0:46:40)

And, you know, it's a strange thing because even skeptics, regular people really don't pay attention to UFOs or this high strangeness or look into it. But when you do, I think that the rewards, and a lot of those are personal, you know, knowledge, the rewards are bigger than the payout. So yeah. And with a lot of these things, there is interconnectivity. (0:47:14)

So there's a oneness to it all. They're interrelated. I believe that the tribes and the oral tradition for over 15 generations that we know of, of something transpiring that is strange, is something you can't ignore. But at the same time, the government has factions within it, that any time there is something that is perceived to be valuable, and even from a fearful perspective, there is a faction of the government that wants to weaponize that for whatever reason. (0:47:47)

And it's in our best interest living in this country for them to know more about those things. At the same time, to your point about the wolves, we've found actual dire wolf remnants on the property, teeth, etc. And that is very real. So I think, to your point, all of these things may be interrelated. Did you find any skulls or bones? (0:48:18)

Lots of bones. We found a few claws, teeth, and it's fascinating. You never know what... and that's just oftentimes, you know, very close to the surface. We haven't done a whole lot of digging. Ryan, as we wrap things up, what's new for you? What's your next project? The next project is going to just figure out why these darn... this last month, these darn structures and buildings have been moving around. And it's a conundrum. (0:48:56)

There's a lot of stuff happening on the surface. And I think we're going to start doing more scanning below the surface. But yeah, that all remains to be seen. Well, stay safe doing what you do out there, Ryan, and keep in touch with us. All right. Thank you, George. Appreciate you.

(0:49:15)

(2025-05-20)

item.title: AI整理 : Bentinho Massaro の精神世界論とその独自性
item.content:encoded:
前置き​

本日の別記事のついでにタイトルの件で AI(NotebookLM) に整理させた。

結果​

AI

添付されたソースに基づき、Bentinho Massaro氏の精神世界的な持論、彼の探求体験、そして主観的な意識の変化についてまとめ、他の指導者との比較から見える彼の独自性を整理します。

ソースから読み取れる彼の精神世界的な持論は以下の通りです。

  • 自己の性質と意識: 彼は自己を非物理的な意識であると認識しています。物理的な現実は、この意識の鏡であり、意識が形作ったものです。意識は肉体の中にあるのではなく、肉体が意識の中にあります [ソースには直接的な記述はありませんが、物理的な現実が意識の鏡である、という記述から推測されます]。全てのものは非物理的な存在または意識の現れであり、テーブルや布、岩のような物理的なものも第一密度の意識の身体であると述べています。

  • 現実と創造: 物理的な現実は鏡のようなものであり、私たちに何かをするのではなく、常に私たちの存在状態、振動態度、意識を映し出しています。私たちは常に現実を創造しており、人生は私たちのキャンバスです。主観的な現実であり、私たちはこのホログラフィックな宇宙を自分の意識の中に映し出すことに同意しているのです。私たちが経験するあらゆることは、何らかの形で私たちのエネルギーによって生成、形成され、経験することに同意されたものです。

  • 振動と周波数: 現実は常に私たちの周波数と一致します。私たちの「振動態度」は、その瞬間の自己の見方、人生の経験の仕方、存在状態であり、放出しているエネルギーや周波数です。この振動や知覚周波数を高めること（幸福、喜び、興奮など物理的に知覚されるもの） は、無限の意識レベルの「はしご」を上昇させることを可能にします。振動を高めることは、自己をより「神」として、より「創造者」として認識し、自己を拡大することです。そうすることで、本来の能力や力をより多く利用できるようになります。

  • 時間と並行現実: 時間は存在しないため、私たちは時間を操作することはできません。存在しうる全てのものは既に存在しており、常に存在し続けます。私たちは常に並行現実へと意識的に、あるいは無意識的にシフトしています。異なる現実の間には距離はなく、同じ意識の特異点の中に共存しています。

  • 身体的不快感: 身体的な不快感は、感情を無視していることの兆候であることが多い（90%の割合）。それは常に振動的な状態の反映です。時には、ネガティブな思考と直接関連しない形で、特定の経験から学ぶために痛みが生じることもあります。

  • 創造のプロセス: 創造は常に現在から過去へと流れており、物理的な現実は常に過去の反映です。新しい創造には時間的な遅延があり、それは「3日プロセス」（象徴的な3段階のプロセス）として説明されています。第1日：新しいビジョン、興奮、情熱。第2日：挑戦、古い信念の表面化と解消。第3日：変容、確認、そして新しい現実の出現。この期間は、創造の性質や個人の意識レベル、過去の「エコー」によって異なります。

  • 自己実現と自己活性化: 自己実現は、個別化された自己から本来の自己を思い出すことで創造プロセスを逆転させることです [ソースには明確な定義はありませんが、以前の会話から推測されます]。自己活性化は、実現したことを現実で活かすことです [ソースには明確な定義はありませんが、以前の会話から推測されます]。 Massaro氏の精神的な探求体験と主観的な意識の変化については、ソースから以下の点が読み取れます。

  • 初期の探求と焦点のシフト: 彼は若い頃に「スーパーマンのような性質」を持っていたと述べています。15歳頃にはテレキネシスを5〜6ヶ月間集中的に練習し、物体を動かす確認を得ましたが、それは「パーティートリック」に過ぎず、重要ではないと悟りました。ペンを動かすことよりも世界を変容させたいと考えるようになり [ソースには明確な記述はありませんが、以前の会話から推測されます]、焦点が物理的なマスターから感情的、精神的、ウェルビーイングのマスターへとシフトしました [ソースには明確な記述はありませんが、以前の会話から推測されます]。

  • 振動の上昇と意識レベルの変化: 喜びや幸福といった高次の振動を高めることが、意識の無限レベルの「はしご」を上昇させると述べています。自己をより神として、より創造者として認識し、自己を拡大することで、自身の意識の周波数が変化し、別の意識レベルに近づくことができます。

  • 「バブル現実」での学習: 彼は、自身の意識の一部を特定の経験をするための「バブル現実」に入れることがあると説明しています。これは、より人間的に（二元性と強烈さの中で）学習体験をするための安全装置であり、そこで経験したいことを達成し抽出すると、バブルが弾け、本来の自己への想起と覚醒が即座に戻ると述べています。彼は無限に学習しており、現在はこの「バブル」を使った学習を深めている可能性があると示唆しています。集団の周波数が上昇すれば、この個人的な学習方法（バブル）を止める可能性もあると述べています。

  • 「透明性」と高次の自己: 以前の会話では、彼の意識がより高次の密度（第6密度）である真の自己に対して「透明」になっており、アイデンティティの感覚が第3または第4密度に限定されなくなったと述べていました。今回のソースでは、彼が集合的に第3密度から第4密度へ移行していると述べています。これは彼の経験と並行していると考えられます。

他の同様の精神世界的な指導者、教師との違い、または彼の独自性について、ソースから直接的な多くの比較はありませんが、いくつかの点から彼の独自性を読み取ることができます。

  • 現実創造への強固な焦点と責任: Massaro氏は、自己を被害者と見なすのではなく、自己の現実の創造者であるという点に非常に強い焦点を当てています。人生が自分に起こるものではなく、自分が創造しているものであるという責任を繰り返し強調しており、これは一部のスピリチュアルな教えにある受動性や「グレース（恩寵）」のみに頼るアプローチとの対比が見られます。彼は、受動的な信仰だけでは不十分であり、意志と信頼（Will and Faith）のバランスが重要であると指摘しています。

  • 実践性への重視: 「見る・感じる・なる（See it, Feel it, Be it）」や、「知っていること（Knowingness）」 を創造のための最も強力な実践として提示しています。特に「知っていること」は思考や信念とは異なる状態であり、これが即座に現実を創造すると説明しています。また、望むものを未来ではなく過去に置くといった具体的な「ワークアラウンド」のテクニックも提供しています。彼の教えは非常に実践的で、現実世界で結果を見ることに重点が置かれています。

  • 「エコー」と「3段階プロセス」の概念: 過去の創造の「エコー」が現在の現実に現れるという概念と、新しい創造が物理的に現れるまでの象徴的な「3段階プロセス」 は、彼独自の、あるいは彼が重視するフレームワークと考えられます。これにより、望む現実がすぐに現れなくても、それが創造のプロセスの一部であることを理解し、落胆せずに周波数を保つ方法を提供しています。

  • 「スモールセルフのファンタジー」と「関連性」の区別: 個人的な欲求（例：特定の車）と、真の自己やより大きな流れにとって「関連性」のある創造との区別を強調しています。創造の本質は特定の物質的なシンボルそのものではなく、それが引き起こす周波数や存在状態にあると教え、シンボルに固執しないことの重要性を説いています。これは、単なる物質的な引き寄せの法則を超えた、より深い理解を示唆しています。

  • 物理現実の鏡としての活用と学習: 物理現実を単なる幻想として否定するのではなく、自己の状態を映し出す「鏡」として積極的に活用し、学習の場と捉えている点、特に彼自身の意識の一部を意図的に学習のための「バブル」に入れるという説明は、彼の経験に基づいた独自のアプローチと言えます。

  • インスピレーション源としての「アイコン」: 自身の内なる振動や本来の自己を見つけるガイドとして、子供の頃のスーパーヒーローや現在の「アイコン」に目を向けることを推奨しています。これは自己探求の入口として分かりやすく、親しみやすい方法です。

総じて、Bentinho Massaro氏の独自性は、現実創造における個人の責任と意志の重要性を強く強調し、実践的で具体的なテクニックを提供する点、創造プロセスの時間的な側面（エコーと3段階プロセス）や欲求の「関連性」といった独自の概念を用いた説明、そして物理現実での学習と統合を重視する自身の体験に基づいたアプローチにあると言えます。彼の教えは、受動的な霊性や観念的な理解に留まらず、意識的な意図と行動を通じて現実を能動的に変容させることに焦点を当てていると言えるでしょう。

item.title: Bntinho Massaro の体験： 精神的彷徨→悟り→虚脱→再構築
item.content:encoded:
前置き​

Bntinho Massaro については過去記事で何度も取り上げたが、今回は彼の

  1. 精神遍歴
  2. 悟り体験
  3. その直後の虚脱体験
  4. 虚脱から再構築へ

に注目する。そして、William James が『宗教的経験の諸相』で扱った宗教心理学の見地から Bntinho Massaro の上記の心理体験を AI に分析・整理させた。

Google の AI: NotebookLM (Gemini 2.0) による分析・整理で、表層的なレベルにとどまってはいるが、一応の参考にはなる筈。
